summary: The team reviewed last week's goals: GitHub commit collection is done, Slack posting works but DMs are blocked on admin approval, and transcript ingestion works for pasted text. The team chose Claude for every agent and Recall.ai meeting captions for live transcripts. The demo script has no owner yet, and transcript retention is still open.

decisions.decision: Use Claude as the LLM for every agent
decisions.rationale: Best structured extraction in team tests; one provider is simpler.

decisions.decision: Get live transcripts from Recall.ai using free meeting captions
decisions.rationale: Ready-made bot for Zoom/Meet/Teams with speaker labels.
